title: Stripe Dashboard
content: Apply Stripe aesthetic with financial platform feel. White background with subtle gray sections. Dense but readable data tables. Small but clear typography. Purple accent color system. Micro-interactions and loading states. Inline actions and quick edits. Comprehensive filtering. Breadcrumb navigation. Activity feeds and logs. Status badges and indicators.

variants.simple: Create fintech dashboard with data-rich displays, clean tables, and professional polish.
variants.detailed: Apply Stripe aesthetic with financial platform feel. White background with subtle gray sections. Dense but readable data tables. Small but clear typography. Purple accent color system. Micro-interactions and loading states. Inline actions and quick edits. Comprehensive filtering. Breadcrumb navigation. Activity feeds and logs. Status badges and indicators.
variants.advanced: Apply Stripe aesthetic with fintech dashboard patterns. Background: bg-white, sidebar bg-gray-50, sections with border-t. Typography: -apple-system font, text-sm base size, text-gray-900 primary, text-gray-500 secondary. Accent: purple-600 for links and primary actions, indigo-500 for secondary. Tables: text-sm, th text-gray-500 font-medium uppercase text-xs, td py-3, hover:bg-gray-50, sticky header. Badges: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs, color-coded by status. Forms: compact, inline labels or floating, clear error states. Sidebar: narrow icon-based or wide with text, collapsible. Metrics: top row of KPI cards, value large, label small, change percentage. Charts: clean line/bar charts with grid, subtle colors. Filters: inline button groups, dropdown selects, active filters as pills. Pagination: simple prev/next or page numbers. Loading: skeleton screens matching content, shimmer effect. Actions: hover-revealed buttons, dropdowns for more. Breadcrumbs: text-sm, gray separator, current page darker. Logs: timestamped list, expandable details. Search: global search with keyboard shortcut hint. Responsive: sidebar collapses, table scrolls horizontally.

author: Ersin KOÇ
